items.title: A24's teaser for Nathan Fielder's Elizabeth Holmes documentary
items.summary: A24 posted the first teaser for You Can See Everything, a documentary by Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim that follows Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes in the 34 days before she reported to prison. People fixated on the close-ups of the two sizing each other up, with one quote calling it "the look of a fake lunatic realizing he's met a real one".
items.author: @A24

post.text: YOU CAN SEE EVERYTHING, a documentary by Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim. Featuring Elizabeth Holmes. Only in theaters this October.
